title: Energy Balance Assessment in Metabolic Cages
author: Jason Kim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xwwfpfe
materials: Metabolic cage food and water baskets are calibrated.
Corncob bedding is added to the cages.
Software is set to collect data at selected interval for 3 consecutive days (72 hour measurement period).

steps.title: Assess body composition
steps.instruction: Measure the body composition of mice to determine whole body lean mass prior to metabolic cage measurement.

steps.title: Prepare metabolic cages
steps.instruction: Fill drink and food baskets with water and the appropriate diet.

steps.title: House and monitor mice
steps.instruction: House mice individually in metabolic cages and monitor them daily to ensure continuous access to food and water.

steps.title: Analyze energy balance data
steps.instruction: Export post-run data and perform analysis using Microsoft Excel, incorporating the previously measured whole body lean mass for energy expenditure calculations.
